text:
Marta G: FYI provisioning for new GPU nodes in sa-east-1 is failing during early boot. Kubelet never registers; saw decrypt errors and assume-role 403s starting ~03:12 UTC. :frowning:
Leo H: saw the alert. We rolled out the tightened egress SNI rules for the region last night (INF-8610). Could be blocking keystore or sts endpoints.
Priya S: grabbed a sample from cloud-init:
```
Mar 10 03:13:07 cloud-init[1]: INFO fetch https://keystore-prx.private.local/v1/decrypt
Mar 10 03:13:08 cloud-init[1]: ERR tls: certificate signed by unknown authority
Mar 10 03:13:08 cloud-init[1]: ERR failed to assume role: POST https://sts-vpc.private.local/assume -> 403
```
Doug M: so two problems: (1) TLS CA chain not recognized by init image and (2) STS principal denied by the vpc endpoint policy because we matched on principal tags. Recent bootstrap role has role=init-node (no team tag).
Marta G: quick mitigation options:
- revert egress SNI rule (fast but broad)
- add host allowlist for keystore-prx + sts-vpc with short TTL and canary in one AZ (targeted)
- route keystore via internal ALB (more ops)
CostOpsBot: ALB adds ~$0.03/hr; NAT per-AZ is ~$0.06/hr baseline. Short TTL host allow is cheapest immediate fix.
Priya S: propose canary plan:
1) patch fw rule sa-east-1-warmpool-egress to allow keystore-prx.private.local (443) and sts-vpc.private.local (443) with ttl=2h scoped to az-a warm-pool only
2) add init-node principal ARN to the vpc endpoint policy in the same AZ (ttl=2h)
3) spin 5 warm-pool nodes (tag: egress-canary=sae1) and reduce audit exporter buffer to avoid OOM during retries
4) monitor cloud-init, kubelet, and audit backlog for 20m
Terraform snippets we will apply for canary (host + endpoint patch):
```hcl
resource "fw_host_rule" "sae1_keystore_allow" {
  name = "sae1-warmpool-keystore-allow"
  vpc  = "vpc-zzzz"
  hosts = ["keystore-prx.private.local", "sts-vpc.private.local"]
  ports = [443]
  ttl   = "2h"
}

resource "vpc_endpoint_policy" "sae1_initnode_allow" {
  endpoint_id = "vpce-zzzz"
  policy = jsonencode({
    Statement = [
      {Effect = "Allow", Principal = {AWS = "arn:aws:iam::123456:role/init-node"}, Action = "sts:AssumeRole", Resource = "*"}
    ]
  })
  ttl = "2h"
}
```
Leo H: also verify that these hostnames resolve to private IPs (no public NAT), regulatory requires keystore traffic stay internal.
Doug M: we'll also grab the server cert chain from the keystore-proxy to validate CA. If init AMI CA bundle is stale, we need an AMI bake with updated CA.
OpsBot: Incident INF-9722 created: "sa-east-1 gpu bootstrap blocked by egress SNI + endpoint policy" assigned to @Priya S and @Doug M. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-9722 :warning:
Priya S: applying host allow and endpoint patch to az-a warmpool now. will post diff.
Leo H: starting canary nodes at 03:22 UTC. I'll tail init and kubelet logs.
Doug M: one canary failed with same cert error; last lines: ```
Mar 10 03:23:11 cloud-init[1]: INFO fetch https://keystore-prx.private.local/v1/decrypt
Mar 10 03:23:12 cloud-init[1]: ERR tls: unknown authority
Mar 10 03:23:12 systemd[1]: cloud-init.service: main process exited, code=exited status=1
```
Priya S: Marcus, can you post the keystore-proxy cert chain and I will compare to AMI CA bundle.
Marta G: quick DNS check: keystore-prx.private.local -> 10.200.3.45 (private ENI). good.
Doug M: confirmed chain includes internal CA but the init AMI is missing the latest CA (rotation last week). short-term: host allow lets nodes reach proxy but TLS still fails until AMI updated. Two immediate choices:
- update AMI CA bundle (longer; bake + roll)
- temporarily allow keystore host and add CA thumbprint exception in fw (ugh)
Priya S: prefer bake. We'll accept a short TTL host allow so we can complete a controlled AMI bake and roll warmpool images. Plan:
1) keep host allow in az-a for 2h so we can bootstrap replacement nodes using new AMI once baked.
2) start AMI bake now with updated CA, aim to replace warmpool images by EOD.
Doug M: canaries re-run after AMI bake (in-progress) and registered at 03:48 UTC. audit backlog drained in ~6 minutes. marking canary success. :white_check_mark:
CostOpsBot: negligible cost for 2h host allow; AMI bake estimated infra cost ~$40 and rollout ops ~2 engineer-hours.
Marta G: follow-ups: (a) bake AMI with rotated CA and stage to warmpool, (b) add preflight to fw pipeline that resolves hostnames AND fetches cert chain to validate CA presence, (c) add principal ARN verification to endpoint policy linter.
Priya S: opening PRs for AMI bake and fw preflight. ETA tonight for AMI bake, will update Jira INF-9722.
Marta G: thanks — closing once AMI staged and runbook updated.
